listing.name: Super Mario RPG: Legend of the Seven Stars (SuperMarioRPGRecomp)
listing.summary: An experimental Super Mario RPG preview dominated by interpreter execution, with only two checked ahead-of-time variants and emulated SA-1 hardware. The Recomp name does not establish a completely native game or complete human playthrough. The project offers a Windows preview; a prior release also had a Linux AppImage using an x86-64 packaging script. Exact Windows package architecture is unconfirmed and no macOS build is established. Use your own matching 4 MiB headerless SNES ROM and the documented exact SHA-256; preparation strips a copier header. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
listing.original_game_title: Super Mario RPG: Legend of the Seven Stars

steps.title: Keep the complete experimental Windows preview
steps.instruction: Use the complete SuperMarioRPGSNESRecomp-windows-x64-v0.0.5.zip folder, including SuperMarioRPGSNESRecomp.exe, its libraries, assets and notices. This early implementation has only two checked ahead-of-time variants and falls back to interpreter execution elsewhere; its SA-1 core is emulated. The Recomp name is not evidence of a wholly native game or complete playthrough. No other-platform observation or native/gameplay qualification is supplied here.

steps.title: Use your own exact SNES ROM
steps.instruction: Supply your own Super Mario RPG: Legend of the Seven Stars ROM. The accepted headerless content is 4,194,304 bytes with SHA-256 740646f3535bfb365ca44e70d46ab433467b142bd84010393070bd0b141af853 and SHA-1 a4f7539054c359fe3f360b0e6b72e394439fe9df. Upstream strips an optional 512-byte copier header before hashing; these are content hashes, not a headered-file digest. Place smrpg.sfc beside the player or choose the existing file in its first-run picker. Preserve PolyForm Noncommercial terms separately from framework/UI/component and original-game rights; no ROM or private translated-output redistribution is granted.

steps.title: Add the ordinary Windows frontend
steps.instruction: Select SuperMarioRPGSNESRecomp.exe, set its complete containing release folder as working directory and leave arguments empty. Review the selected program, folder and arguments, then choose Play when ready and use the upstream launcher. It remembers the selected original in rom.cfg; keep the ROM at that path. Do not substitute a debug, headless or coverage command as the play route. Preserve upstream launch settings and controls rather than replacing them with another SNES title’s defaults.

steps.title: Preserve this title’s actual state files
steps.instruction: Keep rom.cfg, keybinds.ini, the launcher’s settings and the entire saves folder beside the executable, including saves/smrpg.srm and all smrpg*.sav state slots as present. Keep mods, original files and related user data. This title does not use the other SNES family members’ game-owned config.ini; do not create or copy one as a registration step. SRAM, execution snapshots and another title’s saves are different formats; no conversion, cross-build compatibility, import or backup is performed.

steps.title: Keep maintenance and acceptance upstream
steps.instruction: Quit the actual game and helpers before replacing the complete upstream preview or restoring files, preserving the old application/data. Review/select the executable again after changes. Portcove observes the selected program only and removes only its library reference; external originals, saves and runtime files remain untouched. Managed install/update/backup/rollback and Supported qualification are unavailable. Upstream coverage, controller and early-route reports remain separate from actual Portcove native, gameplay and real-save observations.

warnings: Use the complete Windows preview and exact own SNES content. Preserve rom.cfg, keybinds.ini and the whole saves directory; interpreter/SA-1 fallback and incomplete coverage remain explicit.
